tagline: One-click Blender ↔ Maya transfers that keep your materials, geometry and hierarchy intact.

releases.title: Leaner shader graphs and faster instancers

items.text: Hue/Saturation/Value becomes a single Arnold color-correct node for any color range.
Image textures read their own UV set directly, so UV Map nodes no longer add extra Maya nodes.
Displacement now drives Arnold scalar displacement along the object normal, with Midlevel as the zero point.
Shared texture placement nodes are labelled with the Blender Mapping node they come from.
Point instancers from scene transfers build much faster on large scatters.
Import progress no longer forces a viewport redraw on every update, so big imports finish sooner.
PointClouds and Prototypes helper groups are hidden as groups, so their contents stay visible when you need them.
Gamma matches Cycles for linked and negative inputs (Gamma 0 renders white, as in Blender).
Subsurface color is left unconnected when Subsurface Weight is 0, avoiding needless nodes.
Every rebuilt Maya shading node is tagged with the Blender node it reproduces.
An identity Mapping node passes its vector straight through instead of adding nodes.
Missing-image Alpha placeholders can be connected again.
Static scatter particles no longer behave like dynamics on timeline changes.
Float math stays single-channel and colors convert per node, giving smaller, more faithful graphs.
Export Dismiss is now a compact icon so stage labels fit.
Export progress only moves forward across phases.
Keep scene materials skips rebuilding materials for kept objects and retains their full upstream graph.
The import confirmation dialog closes before the import starts.
Geometry Nodes prototypes split by material become a single group instancer.
Each Geometry Nodes Object reference keeps its own prototype instead of collapsing into one.
Every Geometry Nodes mesh occurrence is instanced natively in Maya, with no placed mesh copies.
Instancer shear and collapsed scales carry over exactly.
Principled Volume connects to the shading group's Volume Shader slot.
Imported instancing owners are grouped under a plain transform.
Imports go straight through when nothing from the previous import is left in the scene.
Static scene transfers no longer create selection sets.
Removed helper-text labels from the scene transfer panel.
Static scene transfers no longer add role display layers to your scene.

releases.title: Scene transfer is out of Experimental

items.text: Maya scene transfers drop the Experimental label.
The UV option is now called Skip Inactive UV Maps.
Scene transfers replace same-named Maya objects on first import, just like FBX.
Import dialog gains an Advanced section and a clearer script path layout.
Editable Rig imports show Importing Geometry while geometry loads.
New Include FBX Option preference (off by default).
Maya export settings are simplified: rarely changed options are locked to sensible defaults.
Noise Texture distortion uses Arnold's own noise distortion.
Distorted and fractional-detail Noise rebuild from a couple of native nodes instead of large math networks.
Scalar graph results skip an unnecessary color conversion.
Shader Editor highlights which nodes convert to Maya, with per-node support notes and partial conversions marked yellow.
New QuickExport World panel in Properties > World.
Shared meshes arrive as native Maya point instancers.
Object Info Random carries over for objects and instances.
Editable rebuilds for Wave, Radial gradient, Voronoi, Checker, RGB Curves, Clamp, Map Range (all modes), Fresnel and Layer Weight.
Normal Map, Bump and Displacement chains rebuild as one native graph; Bump distance respects scene units.
Mix and Add Shader trees convert as nested closures, keeping their factors and transparency.
Noise fBM rebuilds as a single native Arnold noise node; constant nodes are folded away.
Textures follow the Blender image color space, including on data sockets.
Orthographic camera framing and lens shift survive the transfer.
Geometry is kept when an individual material fails to convert.
Long Windows texture paths no longer break Arnold texture conversion.
Invalid imports cancel with a clear warning.
Isolated mesh vertices are kept without turning into rendered spheres.
Mark Asset keeps geometry and hierarchy across every placement mode.
Mark Asset is faster on large selections.
Maya Rigged exports default to Editable Rig.
Material exports complete reliably even without progress updates.
Selection works on Windows systems that don't report their architecture.
Mixed procedural colors and the source BSDF behaviour are preserved.
Unshaded subgroup markers no longer interfere with preserved materials.
Review and studio previews use a bundled HDRI, so no download is needed.
Per-face shading assignments survive ordinary replacement.
Materials and hierarchy are preserved when FBX meshes and bones share names.
FBX overwrite resolves object names without grabbing matching rig joints.
Children keep their exact place in the hierarchy during FBX replacement.

archive.summary: Blender normals transfer by default, scene World/HDRI transfer to Maya, Mark Asset for all object types, shared export naming, unused-shader pruning, uncompressed transfers for speed, Editable Rig packages importable back into Blender, and faster Blender and Maya startup.

Transfer progress on the matching Blender button, preserved USD subdivision schemes, editable volume density shaders, Cycles-matched skin SSS, safer rig overwrites and animation fixes, and clearer Maya FBX vs scene-transfer guidance.

New Maya scene transfer with evaluated geometry, animated native rig transfer, reviewed partial rig export, rig control colors in Maya, editable procedural shader graphs in Arnold, Blender-style collapsible export settings, and no more _S material suffixes.

FBX subgroup replacement with rollback, shape-key baking on export, Arnold ColorRamp and specular fixes, ZBrush workflow fixes, Maya setup and update-flow improvements, and preserved face materials on linked meshes.
